podcast.body: Fanny's 1970 debut album showcased their talent, particularly highlighting the drumming. Despite their musical quality, the band faced industry sexism, being expected to prioritize image over their musicianship and songwriting. David Bowie was a notable champion of the band. "Here's a sample from their 1970 debut album, Pay Close Attention to the Drums."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Driven By Her: History of Female Drummers
